config.assignment: fold % 2; identical seed/fold for all methods uses same physical PPU
config.reference: train age mean (standardized zero), train sex proportions; site masked except C4, where train site proportions are the reference
config.shuffle: one fixed label-free random cyclic derangement within site over all 871 subjects per seed/fold; age and sex travel jointly; only PCCI bypass is changed
config.repeat_policy: seed = SHA256(seed/fold/PCCI-repeat-base) modulo 2**32; same draw for C0-C6; native backend and original stochastic VAE/dropout retained

facts: Phenotypes already affect population graph and both GTUNets
Joint 16-D fusion already contains imaging and phenotype features
PCCI measures incremental conditional value on this existing fusion
Paper/source differences and inherited RFE/dropout behavior are preserved
paper_audit.novelty_boundary: FiLM, gating and conditional residuals are established; require paired non-additive diagnostic evidence beyond added capacity
